author: Top Gear
description:
This is the new Brabus Bodo, a 1000hp hyper-GT. But rather than being Mercedes-based (as most of Brabus’s builds are) this one hides the bones of an Aston Martin Vanquish beneath the skin. We love that 835hp British bruiser, but Brabus has cranked a load more power out of the 5.2-litre twin-turbo V12, and dressed it in bespoke – and sublime – carbonfibre body. 

🚗 Brabus Bodo
